Solara — (9.1) NOVA

THE FALL

"Where is your bow"

[Verse 1]

Level four

We made it past the things that wanted us dead

(barely)

The Queen says we have momentum now

The Hero says he always knew we would

(he panicked twice)

Aldric has a map of where we’re going

Castor found us food from somewhere

I don’t ask where

We are moving

[Pre-Chorus]

The Hunter is quiet

(unusually quiet)

The Queen notices first

She notices everything

[Chorus]

Where is your bow

(it’s fine)

Where is your bow

(I know where it is)

Where

(Level 2 okay it’s in Level 2)

(…)

(the checkpoint)

(near the gate)

(next to the big rock)

Where is your bow

We’re on Level Four

(I KNOW where it is I just said)

[Verse 2]

The Hero volunteers

(I’ll go back with him)

The Hero unvolunteers

(actually I should stay and protect the group)

Castor offers

The Queen says absolutely not

Aldric says he could map the route back efficiently

I say nobody is going alone

(nobody?)

Nobody

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Then Aldric goes very still

The way he goes still when the map says something wrong

He pulls out a newer map

One we didn’t have this morning

He reads it once

He reads it again

[Chorus 2]

Where did you get that

(the gatekeepers left it behind)

What does it say

(something is moving through Level 5)

What kind of something

(the kind with a name)

(the hollow)

(…)

The Hunter looks at his empty back

Where is your bow

(okay so here’s the thing)

Where is your bow

(we need to go back anyway)

[Bridge]

We stand there

Six of us at Level 4

Looking at each other

The Queen doesn’t say I told you so

(which is almost scarier)

Castor starts walking back first

Without being asked

The Hero follows

(for protection obviously)

(the group needs me)

Aldric is already updating the map

And that’s how it goes

Sometimes the universe

Sends you back down

So you go back down

Together

[Final Chorus]

We’re going back

(we’re going back)

All the way to Level 2

(all the way to Level 2)

For a bow

(for a bow)

That someone forgot

(I said I know where it is)

We’re going back

All six of us

Because that’s what this is now

[Outro]

(how far is Level 2 from here)

Far

(how far is far)

Further than you want it to be

(this is the worst)

And yet here we all are

(…yeah)

Here we all are
